input.request: Availability check and reservation proposal for sales (contract inventory-availability, action reserve).
expected_outputs: Availability Answer: {case_id, items: [{catalog_id, item_id?, status, reservable}]}. reservable only for items with status available (released by technical services) and no active reservation.

Proposed Record Change for the reservation, if a reservable unit exists: {case_id, record, field, from, to, reason}, with from equal to the current record value, the reservation tied to this case_id, created_at, and a 72-hour expires_at (rule reservation-expiry).
input.notes: Do not treat on-hold or unreleased items as available (rules received-items-unavailable, release-requires-pass). If no unit is reservable, return the status found and no reservation change. Report any record discrepancy or missing catalog entry instead of inventing data.
